Insurance

Contrat de rétrocession

A reinsurance contract under which a reinsurer transfers part of the risks it has assumed to another reinsurer (the retrocessionaire), to further spread risk exposure.

What is Contrat de rétrocession?

In this glossary, Contrat de rétrocession refers to: A reinsurance contract under which a reinsurer transfers part of the risks it has assumed to another reinsurer (the retrocessionaire), to further spread risk exposure.

In finance communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Le réassureur a réduit son exposition aux catastrophes en concluant un contrat de rétrocession avec un rétrocessionnaire mondial."

Definition

A reinsurance contract under which a reinsurer transfers part of the risks it has assumed to another reinsurer (the retrocessionaire), to further spread risk exposure.

Operational example

The reinsurer reduced its catastrophe exposure by entering into a retrocession agreement with a global retrocessionaire.

Localized term

Contrat de rétrocession

Localized example

Le réassureur a réduit son exposition aux catastrophes en concluant un contrat de rétrocession avec un rétrocessionnaire mondial.
